name: amplifier-skill-sizzle
description: A skill that helps agents direct and produce short kinetic brand films with a narrator, a score and cut-downs, then measure every frame and the mix, with a static explanatory site.
runtime: Python >=3.11 (build only); browser (static site). Tools: Node.js with Playwright, Python audio packages, ffmpeg.
publication: Public source repository. Static site publishes to GitHub Pages from main.
